title: Contiguous Array with Equal 0s and 1s

monster.name: Equilibrium Sphinx
monster.title: Measurer of Balanced Binary Segments
monster.defeatQuote: Longest contiguous subarray with equal number of 0s and 1s measured!

description: Given a binary array `nums`, return the maximum length of a contiguous subarray with an equal number of `0` and `1`.
hints: Treat 0 as -1 and 1 as +1. Problem reduces to finding longest subarray with sum 0.
